args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring and the nightly test suite (tests/test_money.py) require
banker's rounding, but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch
the quantize rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values round
to the nearest even cent.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build of `tests/test_money.py` failed because `src/money.py`'s `round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` while the tests (and the FIN-212 policy documented in the docstring) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switch the `quantize` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (including `tests/test_money.py`).

Fixes the nightly build failure related to FIN-212.
